info.title: dotcode
info.description: DotCode CLI - agentic coding in your terminal with any LLM (Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure, Gemini, DeepSeek, Ollama). By Gravicode Studios.

commands.name: serve
commands.description:
Run the JSON-RPC agent server (used by the SDKs and IDEs)
mcp list|add|add-json|get|remove         Manage MCP servers
plugin install|list|remove|enable|disable|marketplace …   Manage plugins
config list|get|set                      View or change settings

commands.name: sessions
commands.description:
List recent sessions for this directory
theme list|set <name>                    List or set the UI theme

commands.name: update
commands.description:
Update the DotCode binary to the latest release
audit verify|path [file]                 Verify the hash chain of the audit log
worktree list|remove <name>|prune         Manage DotCode git worktrees

options.name: --print
options.description: Print response and exit (useful for pipes)

options.name: --resume
options.description: Resume a conversation (picker when no id)

options.name: --fork-session
options.description: When resuming, create a new session id

options.name: --model
options.description: Model for the session: provider:model, alias (sonnet, gpt…) or role

options.name: --fallback-model
options.description: Model to fall back to when the main model is overloaded

options.name: --allow-dangerously-skip-permissions
options.description: Make bypass mode available in the Shift+Tab cycle

options.name: --worktree
options.description:
Work in a git worktree (.dotcode/worktrees/<name>, branch dotcode/<name>);
removed on exit when nothing changed

options.name: --append-system-prompt
options.description: Append to the default system prompt

options.name: --settings
options.description: Load extra settings (file path or inline JSON)

options.name: --mcp-config
options.description: Load MCP servers from JSON files or strings

options.name: --max-turns
options.description: Limit agentic model calls per prompt

options.name: --effort
options.description: Reasoning effort: off | low | medium | high | xhigh
